name: com.bnc.gimac.android.bnccomponentlibrary.FlutterBaseStatusBarTransActivity
description: When BNC GIMAC opens a transparent Flutter screen over the existing app view, this Activity supplies the screen base and transparent status-bar styling. Disabling it can prevent those screens from appearing.
disableEffect: Transparent BNC GIMAC pages, including call-related pages, may no longer open.
